title: The Reform Committee
description: Professor Theron's constitutional reform committee has produced a three-hundred-page draft. He has condensed it to twelve pages. The question is whether to pursue reform through parliament — or through the executive powers the reform is meant to abolish.

title: Budget Allocation — Pre-IMA Review
description: The IMF disbursement conditions are crystallizing. This may be your last chance to adjust the budget before external constraints lock in.

title: Eastern Border Intelligence Update
description: Danika sends a sealed envelope. Not a file — an envelope. Whatever is inside, she doesn't want it circulating through regular channels.

title: Kravenstal Preparatory Briefing
description: Maric is pressing for a visit to Kravenstal. The situation on the ground is deteriorating. Vyktor thinks going now looks reactive. Maric thinks waiting looks callous.

title: Press Strategy Session
description: The Herald is running a series on 'The First 100 Days.' Nadia Voss has been asking questions about the budget process. Vyktor wants to coordinate the government's response.

title: The Archbishop's Dinner
description: Renek invites you to dinner to demand funding for Church schools. It's a shakedown.
